Project name: Thierlavier – Fashion Shop Management System

The streetwear and unisex apparel market in Vietnam is undergoing rapid growth, fueled by youth demographics aged 15 to 30 who seek individualistic identity and contemporary oversized aesthetics. Despite this surging demand, independent local fashion brands face operational bottlenecks that compromise customer acquisition, fulfillment speed, and brand loyalty:
Persistent sizing friction and elevated return rates:

Online apparel buyers frequently encounter sizing uncertainty because most stores offer generic static measurement tables. Customers purchasing drop-shoulder, boxy, or oversized cuts cannot reliably determine whether a garment fits their body proportions and stylistic preferences, resulting in retail return and exchange rates exceeding 15%.
Fragmentation between ready-to-wear retail and custom printing:

Youth consumers and team organizations regularly demand personalized graphics, printed slogans, names, and logos on unisex apparel. In the current commercial landscape, mainstream streetwear brands offer only finished off-the-rack garments, whereas commercial screen-printing providers rely on manual chat inquiries, lack modern street aesthetics, and do not provide browser-based 2D mockup preview tools.
Checkout friction and unauthorized order risks:

Forcing shoppers to register accounts prior to purchasing induces significant cart abandonment. Conversely, allowing completely unverified guest checkout exposes stores to fake orders and failed Cash-on-Delivery (COD) handovers.
Disjointed inventory and multi-variant operational overhead:

Store staff continue to track multi-variant stock (color, size, and SKU), print surcharge rules, bundle discounts, and print approvals through decentralized spreadsheets and social media messaging. This fragmented management produces stock discrepancies, delayed order processing, and revenue reporting gaps.

The Thierlavier – Fashion Shop Management System (FSMS) addresses these deficiencies by establishing an integrated Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) web platform. The system bridges ready-to-wear streetwear sales, dynamic outfit combo promotions, algorithmic size recommendation, browser-based custom print design, verified guest checkout, and unified back-office inventory operations.

Market findings highlight a major structural gap (GAP-01 and GAP-02 in the Competitor Research Report): robust streetwear fashion shopping and self-service customization capabilities currently reside in separate, non-overlapping systems. Retail streetwear webshops provide engaging brand catalogs but completely lack personalized printing options, while custom uniform printers provide functional printing but exhibit outdated user interfaces, non-transparent quote-based workflows, and minimal street fashion appeal.

Thierlavier captures this market opportunity by introducing a unified platform combining single-brand unisex streetwear sales with an integrated browser-based customization studio and automated bundle pricing. By incorporating instant 2D print mockups, real-time surcharge computation, and OTP-verified guest checkout into the primary e-commerce flow, Thierlavier eliminates manual pre-sales overhead, shortens the purchase cycle, and serves both individual streetwear buyers and organized creative crews.
The Thierlavier FSMS platform is designed to achieve the following operational and commercial objectives within 6 months of production deployment:
Achieve an overall checkout completion rate above 70% across both registered members and guest purchasers by removing mandatory upfront registration barriers.
Reduce the proportion of return and exchange requests attributed to incorrect garment sizing to below 8% through product-specific size charts and the Smart Size Recommendation engine.
Decrease operational labor hours spent on pre-order print consultations by 60% by shifting graphic placement, font selection, and mockup previewing to self-service online tools.
Increase Average Order Value (AOV) by 25% through the automated detection and application of promotional outfit combo discounts.
Maintain real-time inventory synchronization across 100% of product variants (SKUs) and track order processing states from placement to carrier delivery via an integrated administrative dashboard.
System performance will be monitored against the following measurable benchmarks:
Guests complete the entire workflow—product selection, custom print configuration, OTP verification, and order confirmation—in under 3 minutes.

Over 90% of submitted Custom Print orders are approved by staff on the first design review due to boundary-enforced safe print zones and file format constraints.
Inventory discrepancies between physical warehouse stock and system counts remain below 2% via automated 15-minute stock reservations during online checkout sessions.
Order return/failure rates resulting from fraudulent contact details or fake orders remain below 5% through mandatory phone OTP verification.

The following non-functional requirements specify the quality characteristics expected of the Thierlavier – Fashion Shop Management System (FSMS). The requirements are expressed using the Planguage approach by defining a measurable quality condition, an evaluation method, and a target level where the project description provides sufficient basis for measurement. The requirements are divided into External Quality Attributes, which describe qualities observable during system use, and Internal Quality Attributes, which describe qualities of the software structure and implementation that support future maintenance and development.
The targets represent measurable project objectives under defined test conditions, rather than absolute guarantees that the system will satisfy the stated level in every possible situation.
At least 99% of access-control test cases for Customer, Staff and Admin must produce the expected results. Passwords and authentication secrets must not be stored in plain text.

Expired OTPs must be rejected. OTP verification and resend attempts must be limited according to the configured rules. This applies to guest checkout, order tracking, cancellation, return and exchange requests.

At least 99% of access-control test cases for personal information, delivery addresses, body measurements, uploaded artwork and order information must produce the expected results based on user roles and account or order ownership.

At least 99% of payment test cases must produce the correct payment status based on validated VNPay transaction and order information. The system must calculate the order total using product prices, quantities, Custom Print fees, discounts and shipping fees rather than trusting the total submitted by the browser.

At least 99% of invalid-order test cases must be rejected before order creation. The system must validate product variants, quantities, stock, vouchers, combos, Custom Print fees and shipping fees for both registered and Guests.

At least 99% of order-processing test cases must produce the expected order, payment and inventory states. The system must not confirm an order for a size-color variant when the requested quantity exceeds available stock.

- At least 99% of external-service failure test cases must preserve the last confirmed business state. The system must not mark payments, shipments or OTP verifications as successful without confirmation from the relevant service.

- At least 85% of representative users must complete each defined task without assistance, including product search, filtering, size and color selection, cart management, voucher and combo application, checkout and order tracking on the defined desktop and mobile screen sizes.

- At least 95% of catalogue and search requests must display the requested results within 3 seconds under the defined test load, excluding delays caused by external services outside the system's control.
- At least 80% of defined change scenarios involving products, orders, vouchers, combos, payments and notifications must be implementable without modifying unrelated parts of the system.

- At least 99% of auditable operations involving products, inventory, orders, payments, returns, refunds and user management must record who performed the action, what was affected, when it occurred and the resulting status or value where applicable.

- At least 95% of the defined desktop and mobile browser test environments must pass the selected core-function tests for product browsing, product details, cart, checkout, account management and order tracking without defects that prevent task completion.

An OTP is valid for exactly 3 minutes (180 seconds) from the time it is issued.
The system must limit OTP requests to a maximum of 3 requests per hour per phone number/email and must temporarily lock OTP requests for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive incorrect OTP entries.
The Total Order Amount is calculated as Σ(Variant Price × Quantity) + Print Fee − Combo Discount − Voucher Discount + Shipping Fee; the calculation must be performed exclusively by the Backend.
The system automatically applies the configured Combo Discount when the variants in the cart satisfy the conditions of an active Combo Program.
An order can contain a maximum of 01 Voucher, and the order subtotal after Combo Discount must be greater than or equal to the Voucher's min_order_value.
A VNPay order can be recorded as "Paid" only when the Backend successfully verifies the HMAC-SHA512 signature, transaction amount, and transaction code received from VNPay IPN.
The Shipping Fee is calculated based on the delivery route/distance and total packaging weight returned or calculated through the Shipping Provider API.
A cart must not contain more than 10 units of the same product variant, and the requested quantity must not exceed the available inventory of that variant.
A product variant must not belong to more than one Active Combo Program at the same time.
A password must contain at least 8 characters, including at least 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, and 1 number.
A newly registered account must be activated through the verification link/OTP sent to the registered email before login is allowed.

The system must temporarily lock an account for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive incorrect password attempts; a Login Session uses a JWT Access Token valid for 60 minutes and a Refresh Token valid for 7 days.
A User can save a maximum of 05 delivery addresses in the personal profile.
When a Guest registers an account using an email/phone previously used for purchasing, the system automatically links the eligible Guest orders to the new account.
The Custom Print Fee is calculated as Base Fee + (Number of Print Locations × Location Unit Price) + Print Type Fee.
A Customer must generate and confirm a 2D preview before adding a Custom Print product to the cart.
An uploaded Print Image must be in PNG or JPG format, must not exceed 5 MB, and must have a minimum resolution of 300 DPI.
The system automatically determines the Suggested Size by comparing the customer's Body Profile and desired fit with the Size Chart of the selected product.
A product categorized as "Unisex" is displayed in both Men's and Women's product filters.
A Customer can submit a review only when the order contains the reviewed product, the order status is "Delivered", and no more than 30 days have elapsed since delivery.
A Return/Exchange request must be submitted within 07 days from the date the order status changes to "Delivered".
A Return/Exchange request must contain a valid reason and at least 01 image/video as evidence of the product condition.
Each product variant must have a unique SKU across the entire system.
A Customer can cancel an order only when its status is Pending or Confirmed; cancellation must not be allowed after the order reaches Ready to Ship or Delivering.
A Custom Print order cannot be cancelled by the Customer after its print status changes to "In Production".

When an order is successfully placed, the system automatically reserves/deducts the required variant inventory; when the order is cancelled or the VNPay transaction fails/expires, the system automatically restores the reserved inventory.
The system automatically triggers a Low Stock Alert when a variant's inventory quantity falls below 10 units.
A product with zero inventory across all variants is automatically labeled "Out of Stock" and remains visible until Staff manually changes its status to "Hidden".
A Voucher must not be applied when the current date/time is outside its validity period, its total usage limit has been reached, or the Customer's personal usage limit has been reached.
A Custom Print order must receive Staff approval of its design before it can enter the production state.
A VNPay refund is processed through the VNPay Refund API, while a COD refund is processed through a manual bank transfer by Staff and then recorded in the system.
Only users with the Administrator role can manage Staff accounts, configure RBAC roles, and access detailed financial reports.

Order status must follow the defined sequence Pending → Confirmed → (In Design Approval → In Production) → Ready to Ship → Delivering → Delivered; the system must not allow status transitions that skip a required step. Terminal states are Cancelled, Returned, and Refunded.
A Voucher/Combo Start Date must not be earlier than the current date, and the End Date must be later than the Start Date.
Products, Orders, and Accounts must not be hard-deleted from the database; their records must be retained with an Archived or Disabled status.

A VNPay payment session can reserve inventory for a maximum of 15 minutes; if no valid payment IPN is received within this period, the system automatically cancels the payment/order and restores the reserved inventory.
A review containing profanity or spam must be hidden, and a Customer can edit a review only within 7 days after posting it.

The system automatically sends notification emails when account activation, password reset, successful order placement, payment confirmation, shipping-status update, or Return/Exchange/Refund result occurs.
After a successful password change or reset, the system must immediately invalidate all active Refresh Tokens belonging to the user on other devices.

For a Return/Exchange caused by a manufacturing defect or incorrect delivery, the Store covers 100% of the shipping fee; for an exchange caused by an incorrect Customer-selected Size/Color, the Customer covers the two-way shipping fee.
